physicalNotes: Radius 0.282 +/- 0.074 solar radii from del Ser & Fors 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of EPIC 201170410.02 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.2778D/abstract): 196,187 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.287 +/- 0.101 solar masses from del Ser & Fors 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of EPIC 201170410.02 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.2778D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3648 +/- 172 K from del Ser & Fors 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 201170410.02 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.498.2778D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

sources.distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.7219 +/- 0.4783 mas (same row, RUWE 8.59): 211.78 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
sources.radialVelocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3786541956697681664 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 70,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%203786541956697681664)
